system.name: ThunderKittens (TK)
system.one_liner: A framework for writing fast, simple AI GPU kernels from a few abstractions: register and shared tiles, tile operations and a producer-consumer program template.

content.variant_note: a memory-hierarchy pyramid beside three role columns (load and store workers, shared buffers, compute workers) that exchange tiles through numbered buffer slots, each role with a cartoon cat and a code listing
content.argues: A small set of abstractions, tiles at each memory level and a producer-consumer worker template, is enough to write efficient AI kernels simply.
content.subject: the GPU memory hierarchy with TK tile types, and load-store workers, shared buffers and compute workers with their code

lessons.what_to_learn: Put a hierarchy (here memory levels) beside the roles that use it: a coloured pyramid whose tiers carry capacity numbers and a banner naming the type used at that level, then one titled column per role with a cartoon avatar and a dashed code box, joined by numbered buffer slots.
lessons.suits: Systems or library papers whose abstractions map onto a hardware hierarchy and a few cooperating worker roles, where real API code can be shown beside the drawing.

evidence: a general kernel template for coordinating asynchronous execution across warps in a thread block, built on the producer-consumer paradigm
workers that load from and store data to HBM, while other workers perform computation in fast memory.

summary: ThunderKittens is a framework for writing fast, simple AI GPU kernels from a few abstractions. Figure 1 puts a four-tier memory pyramid at the left, with registers (64 KB, 130 TB/s), shared memory (227 KB, 33 TB/s), L2 cache (50 MB, 12 TB/s) and HBM (80 GB, 3 TB/s) in four colours; navy banners with tile mosaics name the TK type used at each level (rt<M, N>, st<M, N>, global tensors). At the right, three role columns show the program template: load and store workers, shared input and output buffers with numbered slots, and compute workers, each worker with a cartoon cat and a dashed box of real code, joined by arrows. A robot-cat mascot sits in the corner.
summary_zh: ThunderKittens 用少量抽象写高效 GPU 内核。图 1 左为四层彩色存储金字塔（容量与带宽），横幅标出各层瓦片类型；右为加载存储线程、共享缓冲区和计算线程，配卡通猫和真实代码。
